description:

title: Booked: First Day In
description:
S01 E11 — Busted by Blueberries
In Virginia Beach, a man finds himself in jail over stolen blueberries; a woman who has spent her life running from the law decides to surrender; in Modesto, a professional motorcycle racer hopes to bail out in time to make the nationals.

title: Booked: First Day In
description:
S01 E12 — It's All a Mistake
Speed Racers and a Diplomat charge their way into jail while a jealous boyfriend fights his way in; a hungry homeless man makes a regrettable decision; a pregnant mom is hoping she doesn't give birth while in handcuffs.

title: Booked: First Day In
description:
S01 E13 — It Was Just a Text
In Modesto, a young man is arrested for violating a restraining order by sending a text message; in Virginia Beach, an 18-year-old woman is arrested for assault and battery after a fight with her brother.

title: Booked: First Day In
description:
S01 E14 — Bucket List: Jail
In Florida, an elderly woman gets arrested for domestic battery after fighting with her sister; in Virginia Beach, a 19-year-old boy gets extradited from Miami, after missing his court date, to face an old marijuana charge.

title: Booked: First Day In
description:

title: Booked: First Day In
description:
